description: This file defines the CurlMultiHandler class, which manages asynchronous HTTP requests using curl_multi_* functions in GuzzleHttp. It handles request queuing, execution, and cancellation, and manages curl multi handles.

classes.name: CurlMultiHandler
classes.description: Manages multiple concurrent cURL requests asynchronously, handling request queuing, execution, and cancellation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the handler with optional configuration, setting up the handle factory, select timeout, and options.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Initializes and returns the curl multi handle resource, setting options as configured.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the curl multi handle resource if it exists.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Creates a new Promise for the given request, adding it to the request queue.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Performs a single iteration of the curl multi event loop, handling delayed handles, running the queue, and processing messages.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Runs the event loop until all requests are completed.

methods.name: addRequest
methods.description: Adds a request handle to the queue, handling delays if specified.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels a request handle by its ID, removing it from the queue and closing the handle.

methods.name: processMessages
methods.description: Processes completed curl messages, resolving promises and cleaning up handles.

methods.name: timeToNext
methods.description: Calculates the time until the next scheduled delay.
